feed.title: UAE eVTOL Reference Dataset — recently verified
feed.subtitle: Entities whose claims were most recently re-checked against their primary sources.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi Aviation
entry.summary: Abu Dhabi Aviation (ADA) is the named eVTOL operating partner under Archer Aviation's UAE Launch Edition definitive agreement. Group CEO Mahmood Al Hameli. First Launch Edition payments flowing Nov 2025.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi Cruise Terminal Hybrid Heliport
entry.summary: GCAA design approval announced 23 April 2025. UAE's first hybrid heliport, converting an existing helipad to dual heliport/vertiport use. Partnership between Archer Aviation, Falcon Aviation Services, and Abu Dhabi Aviation.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT)
entry.summary: Abu Dhabi DMT, established by Law No. 30 of 2019, oversees urban planning and transport in the emirate via affiliates including Abu Dhabi Mobility (ITC).

entry.title: Abu Dhabi Network — Route 1 (Abu Dhabi ↔ Dubai)
entry.summary: Archer Aviation and Falcon Aviation plan Abu Dhabi to Dubai eVTOL route: Marina Mall heliport (Corniche) to Falcon Heliport at Atlantis the Palm, ~30 minutes.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi Network — Route 2
entry.summary: Abu Dhabi Network Route 2 is the second corridor in the emirate 10+ vertiport plan. Endpoints not yet published; AUH and AZI confirmed as first anchors.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO)
entry.summary: The Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) is the strategic government counterparty for Archer Aviation's UAE Launch Edition. Director General Badr Al-Olama. Framework agreement signed 25 April 2024 at DRIFTx.

entry.title: Al Bateen Executive Airport (AZI) Vertiport
entry.summary: Al Bateen Executive Airport (AZI) Vertiport is under construction as the second foundational node of Abu Dhabi's 10-vertiport network. Site of Archer Midnight's first Abu Dhabi flight on 2 July 2025.

entry.title: Al Maktoum International Airport Vertiport (DWC)
entry.summary: Al Maktoum International Airport (DWC) was the landing site of the UAE's first piloted eVTOL flight on 9 November 2025. A formal vertiport is not confirmed by primary sources.

entry.title: American University of Dubai Vertiport
entry.summary: American University of Dubai Vertiport — the Dubai Marina node of Dubai's eVTOL network, sited per the RTA 'at Dubai Marina, within the American University in Dubai parking area', Wasl as property partner. Under construction (Skyports, 16 April 2026).

entry.title: Archer Aviation — Abu Dhabi
entry.summary: Archer Aviation's Abu Dhabi launch programme: Midnight eVTOL, ADIO and Abu Dhabi Aviation partnership, vertiport network. GCAA moved Midnight into a Restricted Type Certificate programme on 7 May 2026.

entry.title: Archer Midnight (Abu Dhabi)
entry.summary: Archer Aviation Midnight in Abu Dhabi: first UAE flight 2 July 2025 at Al Bateen, full eVTOL envelope completed November 2025 with Abu Dhabi Aviation.

entry.title: Archer Midnight — UAE Launch Edition Flight Test Campaign
entry.summary: Archer Aviation's Midnight eVTOL completed in-country UAE flight test campaign culminating 14 November 2025. Full-envelope desert testing as part of the Launch Edition program with Abu Dhabi Aviation.

entry.title: Atlantis The Royal Vertiport
entry.summary: Atlantis The Royal Vertiport, Palm Jumeirah node of Dubai's eVTOL network announced 17 November 2025. Joby Aviation, RTA, Skyports - status and sources.

entry.title: Did Not Make The Cut: 13 Entities We Cut
entry.summary: We cut 13 candidate eVTOL entities from the Arab-world database because they failed our contracted/built/flight-tested/regulated bar. Honest disclosure of what was considered and rejected, with primary sources.

entry.title: Dubai Future Foundation
entry.summary: Dubai Future Foundation: Dubai Government's foresight authority. Convening role on eVTOL via Dubai Self-Driving Strategy, drone programme, accelerator cohorts.

entry.title: Dubai Mall Vertiport
entry.summary: Dubai Mall Vertiport, announced 17 November 2025 by Joby and the RTA, with Emaar Properties as the property partner. Construction set to begin in 2026.

entry.title: Dubai Marina Vertiport
entry.summary: Dubai Marina Vertiport is the second node of Dubai's eVTOL network. Confirmed under construction by Skyports Infrastructure as of 16 April 2026, under Joby Aviation's exclusive RTA agreement. Per the RTA the site is within the American University in Dubai parking area — the same facility as the AUD Vertiport entry.

entry.title: DXB ↔ Dubai Mall
entry.summary: Joby Aviation route between DXB and Dubai Mall vertiports, planned for 2026 commercial launch under exclusive RTA agreement. Primary sources verified.

entry.title: DXB ↔ Atlantis The Royal
entry.summary: Joby Aviation route between DXB and Atlantis The Royal vertiport, Palm Jumeirah: ~10-minute flight planned for 2026 launch under RTA exclusive agreement.

entry.title: DXB Vertiport
entry.summary: DXB Vertiport (registered VDX) received UAE GCAA certification on 7 July 2026 — the world's first purpose-built commercial vertiport, developed by Skyports Infrastructure at Dubai International Airport. Certified for eVTOL operations; Joby Aviation passenger service pending launch.

entry.title: EHang EH216-S Mecca Hajj Flight
entry.summary: The EHang EH216-S pilotless eVTOL completed its debut flight in Saudi Arabia on 12 June 2024 during the Hajj season in Mecca. First autonomous eVTOL passenger trial in the Kingdom.

entry.title: EHang EH216-S (UAE)
entry.summary: EHang EH216-S in the UAE: completed the Middle East's first passenger-carrying pilotless eVTOL demo flight in Abu Dhabi on 6 May 2024. Specs and milestones.

entry.title: General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA), Saudi Arabia
entry.summary: GACA published the Advanced Air Mobility Roadmap in January 2024. Issued Special Flight Authorization for Volocopter NEOM flight 21 June 2023. Signed MoUs with Lilium, Joby, Archer.

entry.title: General Civil Aviation Authority — UAE
entry.summary: GCAA UAE is the federal civil aviation regulator overseeing eVTOL type certification, vertiport regulations and Air Operator Certificates in the UAE.

entry.title: Gulf eVTOL — UAE vs Qatar compared
entry.summary: Compares the UAE eVTOL programme (Joby S4 piloted, Dubai 2026 launch) and the Qatar eVTOL programme (EHang EH216-S pilotless, Doha trial Nov 2025).
